---
title: Supported File Formats
execute:
    warning: false
---

Writable versions are in bold.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from dascore.io.core import FiberIO

table = FiberIO.get_supported_io_table(combine_versions=True)
_writers = FiberIO.get_supported_io_table().query("write")
_writable = set(zip(_writers["name"], _writers["version"]))


def _bold_writable(row):
    versions = [x.strip() for x in row["version"].split(",")]
    return ", ".join(
        f"**{x}**" if x and (row["name"], x) in _writable else x for x in versions
    )


table["version"] = table.apply(_bold_writable, axis=1)
table["write"] = table["write"].map({True: "✅", False: ""})
out_str = table.to_markdown(index=False, stralign="center")

out_str += '\n: {.striped}'
print(out_str)
```
